mathematicalProofAndPublicWitnessPrefixe: Byte-identical to the original archived positive scripts; no auxiliary reencoding or padding changes.
codeDelta: Only the recorded mandatory frame guards and derived P2SH transport change. BNlarge4 includes the input2 length<65536 header predicate and exact terminal3 length; BN13 needs one exact carrier predicate. All selected programs match the existing compiled finite-equation theorem identities.
qualification: The source manifest owns exact profile/program identities, accepted finite domains and full ordered-graph/ancestry/VM/field/hash premises. Positive execution alone is not a universal proof or a whole-transaction admission certificate.
nativeAdmission: Per-input results recorded by replay.mjs. Whole-transaction size, fee, relay and mainnet admission are not established.
scope: Mathematical correctness only; existing positive cases. No proof generation, negative-case execution, cybersecurity testing, compiler/prover/planner invocation, or byte/resource optimization.

validation.resourceHolds: BN13 input1 reaches the standard-mode operation-cost density limit in extra-0 and worst-case; all arithmetic-oracle and declared-consensus inputs accept. Halt costs do not measure complete execution costs.
